definitions.explanation: Holes or damage left by insects eating cloth, paper, wood or plants.
A question or puzzle with gaps to fill in, named after the holes insects leave: {虫食|むしく}い{問題|もんだい}, {虫食|むしく}い{算|ざん}.

examples.japanese: {虫食|むしく}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧。

notes:

- {虫食|むしく}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧: a hole eaten by insects

- {虫食|むしく}い{算|ざん}: missing-digit arithmetic puzzle
